# PEN-3925 — keep the root-owned GitHub wrappers ahead of the agent-writable runtime root

Mirrors PR [#2433](https://github.com/Blockcast/paperclip/pull/2433)
(`fix(claude-k8s): keep the root-owned GitHub wrappers ahead of the
agent-writable runtime root`, merged 2026-10-10), which made the identical
change in the `claude_k8s` sibling. Same shape, one directory apart: the two
adapters diverging is the condition that produced PEN-3732 in the first place.

## What was wrong

[pen-3732.md](./pen-3732.md) makes the Job **spec's** `PATH` lead with
`/usr/local/libexec/paperclip/bin`. That is necessary and it is not sufficient.
`buildOpencodeRuntimeShell()` runs *inside* the container, after the manifest,
and bare-prepended its own runtime root:

```
export PATH="$__podir/node_modules/.bin:$PATH";
```

`$__podir` is under the **agent-writable data PVC**
(`<mount>/.local/lib/paperclip-k8s-runtimes/opencode/<version>`). So the PATH an
opencode agent actually resolved against led with an agent-writable directory,
ahead of the wrappers — precisely the condition PEN-3713 exists to prevent. The
Job-spec ordering was correct and then overwritten one layer in. Because the
runtime root is agent-writable *and* agent-created, a Job shadows a wrapper by
CREATING a `gh`/`git`/`github-mcp-server` there, not only by replacing one.

## What changed

`src/server/runtime-pin.ts`:

- exports `IMAGE_WRAPPER_BIN_DIR`, the single declaration site. The managed-CLI
  `PATH` assignment becomes a two-arm `case` that keeps the wrapper directory
  ahead of the runtime root when the wrappers are on PATH, and behaves exactly
  as before when they are not. Keyed off `$PATH` rather than the filesystem, so
  the branch is a pure function of what the snippet inherits: an image that
  predates the wrappers gains no phantom entry.

`src/server/job-manifest.ts`:

- imports `IMAGE_WRAPPER_BIN_DIR` from `runtime-pin.js` instead of restating the
  literal as a local `GITHUB_WRAPPER_BIN_DIR`. **This supersedes the closing
  paragraph of [pen-3732.md](./pen-3732.md)**, which recorded the constant as
  living in `job-manifest.ts` because that was then its only consumer. It is not
  any more — `runtime-pin.ts` keys its ordering off the same directory, so
  declaring it twice could drift into a PATH entry no image carries. That entry
  is left as written; per this directory's append-only rule, a correction is a
  new entry, not a rewrite. The unrelated `GITHUB_WRAPPER_FALLBACK_PATH` keeps
  its name.

## Tests — the actual lesson of this row

`src/server/runtime-pin.test.ts`: new
`buildOpencodeRuntimeShell PATH precedence (PEN-3925)`, four cases that **run
the emitted snippet under `/bin/sh`** with the runtime pre-published and assert
the resulting `PATH`, rather than matching its text.

That layer is the point. **All five PEN-3732 ordering cases passed while this
gap was open** — they stop at the Job spec and the overwrite happens past it. An
assertion surface that stopped one layer short of where the defect lived is why
this shipped; a text match on the new snippet would repeat the mistake.

Two existing text assertions pinned the old bare-prepend literal and were
updated to pin both arms of the new branch: `runtime-pin.test.ts` ("puts the
managed binary ahead of the image binary on PATH…") and `job-manifest.test.ts`
("bootstraps the default pin right after pipefail…").

**Mutation-verified, not assumed.** Three mutations, each killing exactly one
distinct assertion:

| mutation | kills |
|---|---|
| revert to the bare prepend | `keeps the root-owned wrapper directory ahead of the agent-writable runtime root` — `expected 1 to be less than 0`, the wrapper at index 1 behind the runtime root at index 0 |
| loosen the `case` to a substring match | `matches the wrapper directory as a whole PATH entry, not a substring` |
| restate the constant locally instead of importing it | the chart guard's `job-manifest.ts must take the wrapper directory from runtime-pin.ts` |

## Chart-level coverage

`deploy/helm/paperclip/tests/agent-egress-path.test.mjs` now loops both adapters
over the same three assertions — constant declared in `runtime-pin.ts`, imported
by `job-manifest.ts`, and the `case` guard present — where it previously
asserted the claude shape and a deliberately different opencode shape. The
comment recording why they differed is replaced, because they no longer do.

## Latent, not live

There are no `opencode_k8s` workloads, so nothing was resolving `git`/`gh`
through the PVC copy. Same posture as PEN-3732: the cost of a latent gap in a
security control is that it goes live silently the first time an opencode Job is
scheduled. The end-to-end check remains conditional on such a workload existing
— on a live opencode pod, `command -v gh` must resolve into
`/usr/local/libexec/paperclip/bin` and `test -w` on the resolved `gh`/`git` must
be false.

## Scope

`opencode` still resolves to the managed runtime: the wrapper directory carries
no `opencode`, which is what makes this ordering free. The version pin is
untouched. Not covered here: tool shells later source `$HOME` rc files via
`BASH_ENV`/`ZDOTDIR`, and HOME is on the agent-writable shared PVC — a later
writer of `PATH` than this snippet, and a separate concern from this row.
